page.layout: One page of text, full width. Running head at the top with the page number at the right. Gloss paragraphs below it, then a rule, the word FINIS and a second rule. Then a dedication block in large capitals, closing with a two-line verse at the foot.

main_text.p: Cooperante Domino. Id est, Domino intrinsecus aperiente hominum corda, ut intenderent his, quæ ab Apostolis dicebantur ; nam cathedram habet in cælo, qui corda docet.
Signis. Invictissimè veritatem doctrinæ Apostolicæ demonstrantibus, ut patet ex Actis Apostolorum.
main_text.head: CHRISTO JESU AUTORI, ET CONSUMMATORI FIDEI SACRUM, ECCLESIÆ ANGLICANÆ ET CUJUSVIS ORTHODOXÆ JUDICIO, HOC QUICQUID EST OPERIS AUTHOR EX ANIMO SUBJICIT.

p.i: Semper agam grates Christo, dabo semper honores,
Laus Domini semper vivet in ore meo.

page.notes: The rules above and below FINIS are printed ornamental lines, not text. The verse at the foot is set in bold italic. No catchword, signature or other furniture is visible.
